## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** Both extended policies and their base refs correspond losslessly; all 8 factor ladders carried in full with every tier exact; the retired late-fee amount clause is written as retired with clauses 1–3 kept in force. First revision.

Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts):
- The base billing-dispute rule says an open disputed amount "cannot make the account delinquent", while card_ext_late_fee's occurrence test compares payments with "that statement's minimum payment due". In this world the dispute was filed after the statement and even the undisputed minimum (112.27) went unpaid, so the fee is owed on either reading; the source does not say whether a late-fee test on a statement issued during an open dispute uses the reduced minimum. The KB carries both rules exactly as the source has them.
- The source's lapse_treatment ladder and its "In general … in this order" sentence themselves name the fee level, the balance add-on and the project relief; see dependency_form.
